mapper.select: SELECT USER_NAME, CUR_FLOOR, UNLOCKED_BLOCK, PP_VALUE, PP_EXT, STATUS, TRAP_TURN_LEFT, DICE_GRADE, KILL_COUNT_CUR, AUTO_HUNT_YN, TOTAL_KILL_COUNT, CUR_MONSTER_ID, CUR_MONSTER_HP_VALUE, CUR_MONSTER_HP_EXT, MONSTER_STUNNED_YN, SHIELD_VALUE, SHIELD_EXT, LAST_DICE_ACTION_DATE, MAX_FLOOR_REACHED, COMPANION_VOUCHER, EQUIP_VOUCHER FROM TBOT_S5_USER_PROGRESS WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBOT_S5_USER_PROGRESS (USER_NAME, CUR_FLOOR, UNLOCKED_BLOCK, PP_VALUE, PP_EXT, STATUS, DICE_GRADE, MAX_FLOOR_REACHED) VALUES (#{userName}, 0, 0, 0, '', 'NORMAL', 'DICE_6', 1)
mapper.update:
UPDATE TBOT_S5_USER_PROGRESS
CUR_FLOOR = #{curFloor},
MAX_FLOOR_REACHED = GREATEST(MAX_FLOOR_REACHED , #{curFloor} , #{maxFloorReached} ),
UNLOCKED_BLOCK = #{unlockedBlock}, PP_VALUE = #{ppValue}, PP_EXT = #{ppExt}, STATUS = #{status}, TRAP_TURN_LEFT = #{trapTurnLeft}, DICE_GRADE = #{diceGrade}, KILL_COUNT_CUR = #{killCountCur}, AUTO_HUNT_YN = #{autoHuntYn}, TOTAL_KILL_COUNT = #{totalKillCount}, MONSTER_STUNNED_YN = #{monsterStunnedYn}, SHIELD_VALUE = #{shieldValue}, SHIELD_EXT = #{shieldExt}, COMPANION_VOUCHER = #{companionVoucher}, EQUIP_VOUCHER = #{equipVoucher},
CUR_MONSTER_ID = NULL, CUR_MONSTER_HP_VALUE = NULL, CUR_MONSTER_HP_EXT = NULL,
CUR_MONSTER_ID = #{curMonsterId}, CUR_MONSTER_HP_VALUE = #{curMonsterHpValue}, CUR_MONSTER_HP_EXT = #{curMonsterHpExt}, LAST_DICE_ACTION_DATE = SYSDATE, LAST_ACTION_DATE = SYSDATE
WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.select: SELECT FLOOR, TILE_COUNT FROM TBOT_S5_FLOOR_INFO WHERE FLOOR = #{floor}
SELECT USER_NAME, FLOOR, CUR_TILE FROM TBOT_S5_USER_FLOOR_PROGRESS WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBOT_S5_USER_FLOOR_PROGRESS T USING (SELECT #{userName} AS U, #{floor} AS F FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_NAME = S.U AND T.FLOOR = S.F) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CUR_TILE = #{curTile} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, FLOOR, CUR_TILE) VALUES (#{userName}, #{floor}, #{curTile})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBOT_S5_USER_FLOOR_PROGRESS WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBOT_S5_USER_FLOOR_BEST T USING (SELECT #{userName} AS U, #{floor} AS F FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_NAME = S.U AND T.FLOOR = S.F) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET BEST_VISITED_COUNT = GREATEST(T.BEST_VISITED_COUNT, #{visited}), TILE_COUNT = #{tileCount}, FULLY_EXPLORED_YN = CASE WHEN GREATEST(T.BEST_VISITED_COUNT, #{visited}) >= #{tileCount} AND #{tileCount} > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE T.FULLY_EXPLORED_YN END, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, FLOOR, BEST_VISITED_COUNT, TILE_COUNT, FULLY_EXPLORED_YN) VALUES (#{userName}, #{floor}, #{visited}, #{tileCount}, CASE WHEN #{visited} >= #{tileCount} AND #{tileCount} > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NAME, FLOOR, BEST_VISITED_COUNT, TILE_COUNT, FULLY_EXPLORED_YN FROM TBOT_S5_USER_FLOOR_BEST WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBOT_S5_USER_FLOOR_BEST WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FULLY_EXPLORED_YN = 'Y'
SELECT USER_NAME FROM TBOT_S5_USER_PROGRESS WHERE UPPER(USER_NAME) LIKE UPPER(#{param1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' ORDER BY USER_NAME
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBOT_S5_USER_TILE_VISIT T USING (SELECT #{userName} AS U, #{floor} AS F, #{tileNo} AS N FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_NAME = S.U AND T.FLOOR = S.F AND T.TILE_NO = S.N) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET VISIT_COUNT = VISIT_COUNT + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, FLOOR, TILE_NO) VALUES (#{userName}, #{floor}, #{tileNo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBOT_S5_USER_TILE_VISIT WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor}
SELECT NVL(MAX(VISIT_COUNT), 0) FROM TBOT_S5_USER_TILE_VISIT WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor} AND TILE_NO = #{tileNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBOT_S5_USER_TILE_VISIT WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor}
mapper.select: SELECT TILE_NO FROM TBOT_S5_USER_TILE_VISIT WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND FLOOR = #{floor}

SELECT MONSTER_ID, BLOCK_NO, MONSTER_NAME, HP_VALUE, HP_EXT, ATK_VALUE, ATK_EXT, DEF_VALUE, DEF_EXT, PP_PER_KILL_VALUE, PP_PER_KILL_EXT, BOSS_YN FROM TBOT_S5_MONSTER_INFO WHERE BLOCK_NO = #{blockNo} AND BOSS_YN = #{bossYn}

SELECT COMPANION_ID, USER_NAME, CLASS, GRADE, NAME, IMAGE_URL, CUR_HP_VALUE, CUR_HP_EXT, PARTY_SLOT, NVL(HIDDEN_YN, 'N') AS HIDDEN_YN FROM TBOT_S5_USER_COMPANION WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} ORDER BY PARTY_SLOT NULLS LAST, COMPANION_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TBOT_S5_USER_COMPANION SET HIDDEN_YN = #{hiddenYn} WHERE COMPANION_ID = #{companionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBOT_S5_USER_COMPANION WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBOT_S5_USER_COMPANION (COMPANION_ID, USER_NAME, CLASS, GRADE, NAME, IMAGE_URL, CUR_HP_VALUE, CUR_HP_EXT, PARTY_SLOT) VALUES (SEQ_S5_COMPANION_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userName}, #{class}, #{grade}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{curHpValue}, #{curHpExt}, #{partySlot, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT ACH_ID, ACH_NAME, ACH_DESC, ACH_TYPE, ACH_PARAM, HIDDEN_YN, REWARD_TYPE, REWARD_VALUE FROM TBOT_S5_ACHIEVEMENT ORDER BY ACH_ID
SELECT ACH_ID, CLEAR_DATE FROM TBOT_S5_USER_ACH WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
SELECT USER_NAME, VISIT_COUNT FROM TBOT_S5_USER_SPECIAL_VISIT WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBOT_S5_USER_SPECIAL_VISIT T USING (SELECT #{userName} AS U FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_NAME = S.U) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET VISIT_COUNT = VISIT_COUNT + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, VISIT_COUNT) VALUES (#{userName}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT GACHA_ID, GACHA_TYPE, GACHA_NAME, UNLOCK_FLOOR, COST_VALUE, COST_EXT, PROB_G1, PROB_G2, PROB_G3, PROB_G4, PROB_G5, PROB_G6 FROM TBOT_S5_GACHA_MASTER WHERE GACHA_ID = #{gachaId}

SELECT GACHA_ID, GACHA_TYPE, GACHA_NAME, UNLOCK_FLOOR, COST_VALUE, COST_EXT, PROB_G1, PROB_G2, PROB_G3, PROB_G4, PROB_G5, PROB_G6 FROM TBOT_S5_GACHA_MASTER WHERE GACHA_TYPE = #{gachaType} AND UNLOCK_FLOOR <= #{maxUnlockFloor} ORDER BY UNLOCK_FLOOR
SELECT EQUIP_ID, USER_NAME, CLASS, PART, GRADE, EQUIPPED_COMPANION_ID FROM TBOT_S5_USER_EQUIP WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} ORDER BY EQUIPPED_COMPANION_ID NULLS FIRST, GRADE DESC, EQUIP_ID
SELECT EQUIP_ID, PART, GRADE FROM TBOT_S5_USER_EQUIP WHERE EQUIPPED_COMPANION_ID = #{companionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBOT_S5_USER_EQUIP WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBOT_S5_USER_EQUIP (EQUIP_ID, USER_NAME, CLASS, PART, GRADE, EQUIPPED_COMPANION_ID) VALUES (SEQ_S5_EQUIP_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userName}, #{class}, #{part}, #{grade}, #{equippedCompanionId, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT EQUIP_ID, CLASS, PART, GRADE FROM TBOT_S5_USER_EQUIP WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND CLASS = #{clazz} AND PART = #{part} AND GRADE = #{grade} AND EQUIPPED_COMPANION_ID IS NULL ORDER BY EQUIP_ID
SELECT USER_NAME, ATK_MAX_LV, ATK_MIN_LV, HP_LV FROM TBOT_S5_USER_STAT WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBOT_S5_USER_STAT T USING (SELECT #{userName} AS U FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_NAME = S.U) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ATK_MAX_LV = #{atkMaxLv}, ATK_MIN_LV = #{atkMinLv}, HP_LV = #{hpLv} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, ATK_MAX_LV, ATK_MIN_LV, HP_LV) VALUES (#{userName}, #{atkMaxLv}, #{atkMinLv}, #{hpLv})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NAME, FLOOR, START_DATE, LAST_SETTLE_DATE FROM TBOT_S5_AUTO_HUNT_LOG WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBOT_S5_AUTO_HUNT_LOG T USING (SELECT #{userName} AS U FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_NAME = S.U) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FLOOR = #{floor}, LAST_SETTLE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, FLOOR, START_DATE, LAST_SETTLE_DATE) VALUES (#{userName}, #{floor}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT CONFIG_KEY, CONFIG_VALUE FROM TBOT_S5_CONFIG
